original_failed_response_status: The original contents were overwritten in place during repair; no pre-repair backup exists. The original generation command and its text appear in the task tool transcript, but no independent original response artifact is claimed.
failure: Initial run reached upstream interaction.py _func_clean_up; extract_first_json_dict(gpt_response) returned None, then indexing ["utterance"] raised TypeError: NoneType object is not subscriptable. The upstream parser replaces Unicode curly double quotation marks globally, including those inside the utterance string, thereby making this otherwise valid JSON text unparsable.

The corrected text was checked with the upstream extract_first_json_dict parser.
execution: First process exited 1 after six observation scoring calls, reflection generation, reflection scoring, and one utterance call. A restart loaded saved native state and consumed the corrected existing utterance response; it exited 0, generated DONE, and verified save/reload.
execution_json_native_calls_scope: The native_calls value of 1 in execution.json counts only the successful restart process, not all transport calls across both processes.
